trip.en: Our family is planning a trip to the seaside this summer.
trip.cn: 我们家计划今年夏天去海边旅行。

plan.en: Let's sit down and plan the whole holiday together.
plan.cn: 我们坐下来一起计划整个假期。

summer.en: Summer is the best time to enjoy ice cream and swimming.
summer.cn: 夏天最适合吃冰淇淋和游泳。

holiday.en: I'm going to read ten books during the holiday.
holiday.cn: 我打算假期里读十本书。

beach.en: We built a sand castle on the beach last summer.
beach.cn: 去年夏天我们在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

mountain.en: From the top of the mountain we saw the whole city.
mountain.cn: 从山顶我们看到了整座城市。

discuss.en: Tonight we'll discuss our trip with Mum and Dad.
discuss.cn: 今晚我们和爸妈讨论旅行。

idea.en: Sharing ideas with friends makes plans better.
idea.cn: 和朋友分享主意能让计划更好。
